english.title: Interfere with resource main, water main, pipe, structure or installation belonging to water undertaker
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the consent of the water undertaker, intentionally or recklessly interfered with

(A)_[a resource main vested in]_
(B)_[a water main vested in]_
(C)_[a pipe vested in]_
(D)_[a structure, namely **(..SPECIFY STRUCTURE..), belonging to]_
(E)_[an installation, namely **(..SPECIFY INSTALLATION..), belonging to]_
(F)_[apparatus, namely **(..SPECIFY APPARATUS..), belonging to]_ a water undertaker, namely **(..SPECIFY WATER UNDERTAKER..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 174(1)(a) of the Water Industry Act 1991
